name: Do NOT Take This Cat Home
source:
It's your day off, but the weather is really bringing you down.

[s]Among other things.[/s]

But... you're drawn to the distant sound of something calling out to you...

You follow it to a dark, lonely alley. And at the back of the alley, in a cardboard box...is a cat.

A very cute cat.

What will you do?

Will you [s]selfishly[/s] ignore it and go enjoy your day off?

Will you befriend it [s]only to abandon it anyway[/s]?

Or...

...Will you take it home with you? Surely you will, right?

Right. Who could say no to that face~?

[From [url=https://pixeliminal.itch.io/do-not-take-this-cat-home]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是你的休息日，但天气却让你心情沮丧。

[s]除此之外[/s]但是……你被远处有东西呼唤你的声音所吸引……

你跟着它来到一条黑暗、孤独的小巷。在小巷后面的一个纸板箱里……有一只猫。

一只非常可爱的猫。

你会怎么做？

你会[s]自私地[/s]忽略它并去享受你的假期吗？

你会和它做朋友[s]但还是放弃它[/s]吗？

或者…

……你能带它回家吗？你肯定会的，对吧？

正确的。谁能拒绝这张脸呢~？

[来自[url=https://pixeliminal.itch.io/do-not-take-this-cat-home]itch.io[/url]]
